speaker: Doctor
text: I am sorry to hear you are feeling so unwell. To better understand the cause of your fatigue, weight loss, and malaise, have you noticed any night sweats or a persistent fever recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant amount of weight loss; besides the fatigue and malaise, have you experienced any persistent cough, shortness of breath, or changes in your voice lately?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your concern; given your age and the significant weight loss, we must rule out serious underlying causes. Do you have a known history of smoking, and have you noticed any lumps in your neck, armpits, or groin? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature 36.7°C (98.0°F), Blood Pressure 126/74 mmHg, Heart Rate 87 bpm, Respiratory Rate 17 breaths/min. Examination: General appearance is chronically ill. Bilateral cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy palpable. Splenomegaly present. Complete Blood Count: WBC Elevated with lymphocytosis; Hemoglobin Normal to slightly decreased; Platelets Normal to decreased.
